object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests. Each place is tried alone, so the order between places is a gap.
object.description: On a computer without draw.io desktop, set MELLON_DRAWIO; separately, put draw.io.exe in %ProgramFiles%\draw.io, then in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\draw.io; separately, put drawio on PATH; and finally have none of them. Expected: each time Mellon finds the program at that place, and with none it finds no program.
